entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.zh: 有明亮彩色门窗的白色房屋

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives

entries.zh: 像混凝土丛林一样散开

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Nestled at the foot of the mountain

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 看起来像一个不太可能的地方...

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs

entries.zh: 和街上音乐家和街上咖啡馆一起

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Alive with smells from the food stalls
entries.zh: 活着的气味 从食物摊

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Grime and pollution clung to the houses

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Waste pumped and dumped into the river

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a quaint town, with narrow, cobbled streets.
entries.zh: 原为古镇,街道狭小,杂交.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The picturesque market town was surrounded by gentle hills and leafy lanes.
entries.zh: 图片集市小镇被温和的山丘和多叶的车道包围.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The sea-side town was a small, enchanting haven from the polluted city.
entries.zh: 海边小镇是一个小的,迷人的避风港 从被污染的城市。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Ahead of him on the rocky coast was a quaint fishing village.
entries.zh: 在岩石般的海岸之前,他是一个奇特的渔村.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The ancient town was a warren of tunnels and narrow, twisting alleys, and a maze of buildings.
entries.zh: 古镇原是隧道和狭窄,曲折的巷子,建筑的迷宫.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a colourful, cosmopolitan city. The street markets filled the air with an exciting mix of smells and sounds from around the world.
entries.zh: 这是一个多彩的宇宙城市,街道市场充满了来自世界各地的令人兴奋的气味和声音。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wide, tree-lined streets were bright and cheerful, lined with pavement cafes and alive with the sounds of street musicians.
entries.zh: 宽阔的树线街道光亮而欢乐,有铺设的咖啡馆,有街上音乐家的声音。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The city was bustling with tourists, eager to explore the scores of shops, art galleries and museums.
entries.zh: 城市里挤满了游客,渴望探索商店,美术馆和博物馆的数十家.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Nestling around the village green, the sleepy village seemed an unlikely place for an adventure.
entries.zh: 在村里的绿地上 困满的村子 似乎不可能是冒险的地方

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The village was no more than a pile of stones and shattered walls.
entries.zh: 该村只不过是一堆石头和破碎的墙壁。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She lived in a run-down part of the city. Wood, not glass, filled the windows.
entries.zh: 她住在城市的一个破旧地方 木头,不是玻璃,是装满窗户的

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Graffiti covered the walls. Rotting rubbish and broken glass lined the streets.
entries.zh: 葛拉菲蒂把墙盖了起来 垃圾和玻璃破碎铺满了街道

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Plastic bags and crisp packets flapped like streamers from the trees. Empty drink bottles rattled in the gutter.
entries.zh: 塑料袋和脆薄的包裹 像是树上的流水瓶 空瓶子在水沟里响起

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They could see the city spread out before them, with its black veil of smoke and towering chimneys.
entries.zh: 他们可以看到这座城市在他们面前蔓延, 上面有烟雾和烟囱的黑纱。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Most of the houses had been built from cardboard, or anything that could be rescued to provide shelter.
entries.zh: 大部分房屋是用纸板建造的,或任何可以拯救以提供住所的东西。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The houses were crowded together and blackened by soot and smog.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a ghost town of deserted houses crawling with mould and damp – empty shells with gaping windows like haunted eyes.
entries.zh: 这是一个鬼城,荒废的房屋 爬上模具和潮湿的, 空壳 与裂缝窗户 像鬼眼。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Years of grime and pollution clung to the houses, spewed from the big, ugly factories that shadowed the streets.
entries.zh: 多年的黑暗和污染笼罩着房屋, 从遮蔽街道的大丑陋的工厂里涌出。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A warren of secret, underground tunnels and cellars was used to move around the city and to hide from invaders in times of danger.
entries.zh: 一个秘密的,地下的隧道和地窖的警报器被用来在城市周围移动,并在危险时期躲避入侵者.
